answer: In PoA, every identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, but equivocation evidence links coordinated keys: when k identities sign conflicting histories, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2) through pairwise attribution rather than linearly. Upon detection, the swarm also receives an exponential multiplier on capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery through stake splitting. Consequently, an operator at a wharf, behind a mirror, or in a walnut-sized facility cannot cheaply expand a deceptive cluster.
